story_text: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.

positive.title: Log in with valid email and password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and the correct password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in with valid email including subdomain and correct password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email with a subdomain (e.g., 'user@subdomain.example.com') and the correct password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in with valid email in UPPERCASE and correct password
steps: 2. Enter a valid email in UPPERCASE and the correct password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in with valid email and valid password that includes special characters and numbers
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a valid password that includes special characters and numbers (e.g., 'P@ssw0rd123').
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in with valid email and valid password that is the maximum length (e.g., 128 characters)
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a valid password that is the maximum length (e.g., 'P@ssw0rd1234567890').
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in directly after registering a new account with valid email and password
steps: 2. Fill in the required fields to create a new account.
4. Once registered, navigate to the login page.
5. Enter the same email and password used for registration.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in with valid email and password after logging out from a previous session
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button to end the session.
3. Navigate back to the login page.
4. Enter the same valid email and password used for the previous login.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

positive.title: Log in with valid email and password after a failed login attempt
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and an incorrect password.
3. Click the 'Login' button and observe the error message.
4. Re-enter the same valid email and the correct password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard after correcting the password.

positive.title: Log in with multiple registered accounts using valid email and password for each account
steps: 1. Register multiple accounts with different valid emails and passwords.
2. For each registered account, navigate to the login page.
3. Enter the valid email and corresponding password for that account.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

negative.title: Log in with empty email and password fields
steps: 2. Leave both email and password fields empty.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for empty email and password fields.

negative.title: Log in with empty email field
steps: 2. Leave the email field empty and enter a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for empty email field.

negative.title: Log in with empty password field
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and leave the password field empty.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for empty password field.

negative.title: Log in with unregistered email
steps: 2. Enter an email that has not been registered and a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for unregistered email.

negative.title: Log in with invalid email format
steps: 2. Enter an invalid email format (e.g., 'userexample.com') and a valid password.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for invalid email format.

negative.title: Login with password that is case-sensitive and entered in the wrong case
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a password that is correct but entered in the wrong case (e.g., 'p@ssw0rd' instead of 'P@ssw0rd').
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed for invalid password.

edge.title: Login with the email minimum valid length
steps: 2. Enter a valid email that is the minimum valid length (e.g., 'a@b.c') and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

edge.title: Login with the email maximum valid length
steps: 2. Enter a valid email that is the maximum valid length (e.g., 254 characters) and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

edge.title: Login with the password minimum valid length
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a password that is the minimum valid length (e.g., 8 characters).
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

edge.title: Login with the password maximum valid length
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a password that is the maximum valid length (e.g., 128 characters).
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

edge.title: Login with email that has leading and trailing spaces
steps: 2. Enter a valid email that has leading and trailing spaces and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

edge.title: Login with password that has leading and trailing spaces
steps: 2. Enter a valid email and a password that has leading and trailing spaces.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

edge.title: Login with the same account from multiple devices simultaneously
steps: 1. Log in to the account on Device A with valid email and password.
2. While still logged in on Device A, navigate to the login page on Device B.
3. Enter the same valid email and password on Device B and click the 'Login' button.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.
